content:
The rebate is a fixed 3000-cent amount, not a percentage or a reduction to every invoice. It can reduce total net charges below the COMMIT activation charge.

Net cost includes every posted activation and remittance charge less a posted rebate. Switching plans cannot retroactively qualify earlier executions.

Qualification flags describe the commercial category on the invoice, not an authorization to change its principal or split its required whole remittance.
